reviews.text: Very well organized and effective
Empathetic, honest, and professional. They took great care of my cat, and I'm grateful for giving me the peace of mind that everything possible was done.
Great atmosphere and great staff.
I recently visited the clinic for a minor dental procedure on my little bunny; I found the staff to be very welcoming and knowledgeable.

Positive experience. On Sunday morning, after fleeing another clinic in Ostia, we took our cat to the clinic for blood in his urine.
We waited 10 minutes for the emergency level to be determined. Since it wasn't life-threatening, we waited calmly (about an hour) and after the doctor's examination and the relevant prescriptions, we left. The price for the weekend visit, including the administration of an anti-inflammatory, wasn't too high.
Excellent reference point.
Dr. Sangiorgi, very good, very gentle, a true professional with a big heart...she saved my Lolita🩷 …

I've been bringing my beloved pets to the Omniavet clinic for 15 years and have always had a great experience, not just good! I have great faith in the veterinarians who work there, especially Dr. Tarsitano, who treats my dogs with meticulous care, professionalism, and compassion. The staff at the front desk are also incredibly kind; I've had a long-standing relationship with Daniela. In surgery, a special mention goes to Jacopo, always attentive and thorough. Even now that I've moved to Formello, a few kilometers away, in the northern province of Rome, they continue to be my trusted veterinarians! Overall, 10 out of 10 for everything!
The medical and administrative staff are friendly and empathetic, and their expertise and, above all, willingness to help owners through their pet's care journey are key. I highly recommend them.

I went to this veterinary clinic on a Saturday afternoon because my regular vet was closed. My puppy was complaining of abdominal pain, but otherwise he was fine: he was walking, playing, and eating greedily.
After the visit, I was given a very high estimate for diagnostic tests and a two-day hospital stay. The diagnosis was a buildup of material in the colon/intestine. I accepted the hospital stay, which included fluid therapy, trusting their judgment and thinking it was the best choice for my puppy.
When I finally brought him home, however, I found a completely different puppy: apathetic, unwilling to eat, extremely weak, to the point of barely standing, and with persistent abdominal pain.
My experience was extremely disappointing. I incurred a significant expense without seeing any improvement in my dog's condition; in fact, I felt the hospital stay had caused him considerable stress. To this day, I deeply regret having made that decision, convinced I was doing him the best thing.
This was my personal experience, and based on it, I wouldn't recommend this clinic. If you love your pets, I suggest you carefully consider other facilities before making a decision.
A special thanks to the doctor who operated on my cat…I will be grateful to you for the rest of my life.

ALE, thank you for all the good advice you've given us over the years, and thank you for accompanying us through the end of our friend's journey in a way that goes beyond professionalism. And thank you to all the staff who welcome us, the owners, with incredible patience. Heartfelt thanks to all of you who do your job with love.

GIORGESCHI

My Cana swallowed a whole skewer, toothpick and meat included.
They saved her.
Thank you so much.
Everyone was super kind and knowledgeable.
A special thanks to Giulia, kind, thoughtful and super helpful, you can see that she does this job with her heart 🩷 thank you thank you thank you …
Only 4 stars, but perhaps they deserve more. The fact is, there are always too many people and too many animals to care for. And the wait is long. They should organize the reception a little better.

We went because they told us there was a veterinarian there who cared for exotic animals. We found a parrot that had fallen from a tree. The Italian Lipu (Italian Parakeet Protection Association) was closed, and we couldn't keep it at home due to the presence of felines. We were treated with complete disregard. We had no money and were not even interested in seeing the animal in question.
But where have we ended up... pure madness and inconvenience. The local pet food store, however, was very kind in helping us.
They are very good, competent, and very sweet with all these wonderful creatures. A special thanks to Dr. Menasci for being by Mister's side at all times.

I went to them for the first time on Sunday and was greeted by a helpful and knowledgeable nurse. I received excellent treatment!! Dr. Valeria Sartori took care of my dachshund, who had been vomiting for 2 days. She performed an ultrasound with extraordinary care and dedication. I was promptly diagnosed and treated. Thank you so much!!! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this place; it's run by the right, knowledgeable people.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Omniavet Veterinary Hospital. From the very first moment, I found the staff magnificent: kind, helpful, and highly competent. At a time of great concern for my sweet little puppy, all the doctors and staff made me feel welcomed and supported.

Thanks to their professionalism, care, and dedication, they managed to save my puppy, and for that I will always be grateful. It's clear they carry out their work with passion, compassion, and love for animals.

I highly recommend this facility to anyone seeking high-quality veterinary care. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for what you've done for us. Thank you ❤️

Professional, meticulous, and attentive in every way.
I recommend them.

Avoid like the plague. I brought the dog in in terrible condition and they didn't give me any treatment to do at home, but instead gave me other tests and unnecessary things to do since they weren't relevant to the current problem. (This was from my trusted vet.)
Furthermore, the X-ray I paid for, which was also included in the diagnosis, is now being denied and hasn't been given, so I paid for it! Now I'm going to another doctor, and he's telling me how the dog could be like this if he already had a visit for the same thing a month ago. Don't trust them, and especially don't leave your four-legged children with them. They're unprofessional, and they only care about taking money away from you instead of helping these little creatures.

You're only thinking about increasing your own pockets instead of caring for the animals.

Unfortunately, our experience with this clinic was not positive.
We admitted our cat for a serious urinary problem. We understand that treatment, hospitalization, monitoring, and tests are expensive, and we don't dispute this.
The main problem was communication.
During the hospitalization, we were told we would be called back with updates, but that wasn't the case, and we had to search for information about our cat ourselves. Contacting the clinic was often very difficult, and getting answers required numerous attempts.
The most serious thing for us was that, after a test performed on our cat, we were told the results would be available within about a week. More than a month has passed, and we still haven't received any communication or results.
In a veterinary clinic, it's not just the animal's care that matters, but also the support and communication with those waiting for it at home, especially after significant expenses.
We often felt left alone and forced to chase information that should have been communicated to us.
The doctors are highly professional and the entire staff is extremely courteous. Everyone is very gentle and attentive when interacting with the furry friends.

My Chihuahua was feeling unwell, and I took him to the clinic as an emergency. The staff was kind and helpful, and the doctors were very competent, friendly, and empathetic. A special thanks to Dr. Gaspari, who is treating little Roy.
Excellent vets who treat animals with love. They're also open late at night for emergencies.

I speak for ESOVET exotic animals, with which I have experience.
These highly trained and loving doctors demonstrate great patience, dedication, sensitivity, and care.
They are actively present for constant updates if hospitalization is necessary.
I come from Rome.
Kindness and compassion for our animal friends. Always welcoming, even in the most difficult situations. Payment options available, clear quotes, and 24-hour service.

My Melody had surgery at this clinic... everything went well... but she had to be picked up and returned at the end and was traumatized for 10 days because I couldn't be with her due to the anesthesia. Very professional, but maybe a little more space for the relationship!

The center cared for our dog Minou from when she was a puppy until she fell asleep. Fabio, and the entire team of veterinarians and assistants, were always highly professional and competent, but also infinitely human, kind, and always available. Thanks to Dr. Fabio and Alessandro for caring for Minou and supporting "Grandma" Fabiola with such kindness and patience.

The staff is careless and even incompetent! My mother's dog had a cyst between her toes! The "doctor" told us her leg needed to be amputated. Of course, it didn't take a doctor to realize it was a huge mistake. We went to another veterinary clinic where they removed the cyst. She lived a healthy life until old age took her.

I arrived in Italy from France a few months ago and was recommended the Omniavet veterinary clinic.
From the first appointment, I found the entire staff to be very kind and professional, always providing clear explanations.

Changing countries is not easy, especially when you're unfamiliar with the system, but thanks to Dr. Sartori, I immediately felt at ease and free to ask all the necessary questions. She is extremely helpful, clear in her explanations, and very attentive to both me and my dog, Lucky.

Furthermore, I found the rates very reasonable, especially compared to those in France.

A big thank you to Dr. Sartori and the entire Omniavet team.
I recommend her 100%.

I took my 11-year-old cat to this clinic exclusively because, being Sunday, it was the only facility open.
The cat was having difficulty breathing, labored and labored, but before entering the clinic, she was moving, jumping, and running, despite her breathing problem.

I was told she was suffering from pericarditis and that a tamponade was necessary. I was given a quote of approximately €600 to sign, but I had to ask for the total, because initially I was only shown the individual costs. The quote included all post-drainage expenses, any CT scans, hospitalization, and follow-up checks to prevent the problem from recurring.
At no point was the possibility of my cat dying from the procedure or that there were immediate risks to her life. On the contrary, I was implicitly given the impression that there was no imminent danger and that any complications could arise only in the event of a recurrence.

The doctor present didn't even introduce herself: I didn't know her name or her role. After taking care of my cat, I was told she had "collapsed," without any explanation of what had happened. An event that, incidentally, had never been mentioned to me as a possible scenario.
The communication was completely tactless and extremely confusing: I was given conflicting and inconsistent versions of the moment of collapse, repeatedly changing stories (first before the drainage, then during, then again before).

A profoundly traumatic experience, marked by a complete lack of clarity, empathy, and professionalism in the explanation of the problem and in the manner in which such grave news was communicated to me.
Advise
I've been bringing my pets to this clinic for years and have always been very satisfied. The doctors are all competent, knowledgeable, and very understanding. Thank you, Omniavet Clinic!

Since our veterinary practice was closed on Sunday, we unfortunately went to the Omniavet clinic to put our elderly, sick, and very suffering cat to sleep. We met Dr. Rachel Menasci, whom we'd like to commend for her extraordinary care, kindness, and empathy, both with our suffering cat and with us. These are things that can't be taken for granted, and it was truly a gift, for which we thank her from the bottom of our hearts.
Useless secretaries: they don't answer the phone and give the wrong appointment times.
Thank you ♥️

I'm sorry I can't give fewer stars. Please don't go there. I found the doctor incompetent. It got worse after going here; four other doctors at four facilities said every procedure they performed was wrong and risky. Protect your dogs.
too expensive! It costs a lot!!

Omniavet is the clinic where our dog has been treated since she was born and where she has always been welcomed with love and professionalism. We have faced many unusual situations due to domestic accidents, which were resolved promptly and concluded in the best possible way. I conclude by saying that, in addition to our Heart Doctor, our other emergency room experiences with other doctors have also always been perfect.

We brought our dog for a pyometra problem. The staff was prompt, competent, and very helpful. The problem was resolved after the operation. We went for a check-up and everything went well. I recommend this clinic.

I took my cat to them for a vaccination. One day, I had an appointment at 5:30 PM, and they let me in at 7:00 PM. Despite my reminders, they made me wait another 30 minutes. The vaccination took less than 10 minutes. It was the second vaccination, and I didn't even get a chance to speak to the doctor who administered the first vaccination. After this, I called them to see if my cat was ready for neutering, and the secretary told me she'd get back to the doctor to discuss it because she was busy at the time. I never received a call back. I changed vets. I just didn't feel comfortable. I hope for a little more professionalism for future visitors.

My dog ​​was diagnosed with a torn ligament in his right hind leg, which included an examination and x-ray under sedation for €120, plus a prescription for a nutritional supplement that was useless due to a suspected bone malformation of the knee. The results were negative. I received an estimate for surgery for €1,800, for which I had to take out a loan. I took the dog to a vet who specializes in bone surgery, and the result: the dog has no torn ligament, and surgery is not necessary, and it is almost never performed on small dogs under 15 kg. Specific treatment was prescribed, and the dog will be able to return to his normal life within a couple of months. I have so much to say... but I'll limit myself to describing the facts.

I'm talking about three years ago. My 10-year-old cat was practically paralyzed from the pain and couldn't move without crying agonizingly. I live outside of Rome, so I took him to a local vet, who didn't realize he had a cat. Then to another vet, and another! The third vet I visited told me that, unfortunately, the cat had FIP and was doomed to die. In desperation, I took him to Omniavet, recommended by a friend. They examined the cat thoroughly and studied blood tests already done there. They discovered that the pain was caused by severe gland inflammation. After a week of antibiotics, my cat was back to normal. Now he has another problem, and I'm not even thinking of taking him anywhere else. I'm going to see them today.

As a veterinary center, it's excellent, with good vets. But as for service, it's terrible, to say the least. The staff is rude and unhelpful, especially the reception staff... I recommend you change staff. You'll lose a lot of customers this way. Speaking to friends and acquaintances, they've all had the same problems.
Not even that star. Terrible.

I had to spay my kitten, and I was nervous at first... but the staff at the Omniavet clinic reassured me. They were very kind, understanding, and helpful. When I picked her up, the kitten was already awake and lively, you can't even see the scar... Thanks Fabio! 😊
Cinzia …
Terrible…..I won't say anything else
A month after my Kira's death, I'm giving 4 stars only to thank Dr. Gaspari, who always took care of my Kira, and Dr. Tarsitano...
Simply thank you, a second family for my animals. Thank you. Sincerely touched, Lucrezia, Gabriella, and Claudia. 💙 …

My 14-year-old dog underwent major surgery (after all the necessary checks) at this clinic. I want to say that she has always been very afraid of vets, but with them, despite some understandable fear, she lets us approach her with confidence!
I sincerely thank Dr. De Cesare for his professionalism and his great humanity and empathy, always available and attentive, even outside of office hours. We couldn't trust anyone better. A sincere thank you also to Dr. Mensaci, who, one evening when my dog ​​had a post-op problem, immediately intervened with kindness and helpfulness. Since then, every time we see her, she never fails to give her a cuddle: she too is extremely empathetic and professional.

Thank you for everything the wonderful staff at the Clinic did for our dog Sansone.
In particular, to Dr. Valeria Sartori, who, with professionalism and love, cared for and treated Sansone.
Thanks, too, to the other doctors and nurses who cared for our puppy.
Thanks also to Daniela, the clinic's bursar, who is incredibly kind, even though she has the most difficult task: the final bill...
Stefano di Sansone

We brought our Weimaraner to the clinic after being diagnosed with pneumonia at another center. After undergoing a course of antibiotics with no results, we were given the same treatment again. We then turned to the Omniavet clinic for a second opinion and to understand the problem. Thanks to Dr. Zeni and the rest of the team, we discovered that the pneumonia was actually caused by reflux and therefore intestinal problems. After cortisone therapy and a change in diet, the situation finally improved. Thank you!
Helpful and kind staff, meticulous and professional doctors. A special thanks to Dr. Zeni, who cared for my pointer throughout the entire process with care and love!

Thank you to Dr. Alessandro Ferdinando De Cesare for his compassion, humanity, and above all his professionalism. An exceptional doctor in every way, a wonderful and highly trained team of staff in whom you can fully trust.
Thank you for caring for our Mina, with great professionalism and a rare kindness. Seeing our animals suffer is devastating, but finding true professional, knowledgeable, and caring support is a great help for us and especially for our four-legged friends.
An excellent facility that truly made a difference in our difficult time.
Thank you so much for everything, Mina.

They gave me my life back twice over... Thank you. If it weren't for their expertise and timely intervention as soon as they arrived in the emergency room, my dog ​​wouldn't still be with us! And not only that, they also offered first aid to my father, who had dog bite wounds, before we could go to the emergency room! Thank you for everything! Expertise and professionalism, and I must say all the medical, nursing, and administrative staff... absolutely amazing!!! A special thanks to Dr. Tarsitano for how he handled the clinical and emotional aspects from the beginning, to Dr. Sartori, whom I met several times during visiting hours and who always showed transparency and precision in explaining the clinical picture to us with empathy and kindness, and a thank you to the fantastic Daniela at the front desk, always active and available for any requests and problem resolutions... of course, thanks to everyone 🙂
Love, Arianna and Mac 🐾
With their humanity and professionalism, they accompanied my Camilla both during her hospital stay and until her last breath. Thank you all ❤️

The number one pet doctors. If I had to entrust my pet's life to a veterinary clinic (as I did), it would be them. Competent, empathetic, affordable, helpful, and friendly. They always have a smile and know how to best respond to any situation. Open 24/7. The absolute best!

I've been taking my dog ​​for checkups and visits for years, and the professionalism and kindness of the staff is undeniable. The day before yesterday, she underwent TPLO surgery for a torn knee. It was an invasive operation that was performed excellently by the staff, who were also kind enough to address my concerns. My dog ​​is already walking after two days, and they even asked me how her wound was doing after the surgery. Thank you to the entire surgical team and the entire Omniavet clinic.
Very long wait (45 min) for a sick dog with an appointment

The empathy, kindness, and sensitivity we encountered truly left us speechless. Thanks to everyone, from the secretary to the doctor who accompanied our Maremmana on the bridge, and to Dr. De Cesare, who was with us from the very first moment! 🙏🏻 …

Omniavet is not recommended to anyone due to their lack of desire to work. They only care about saving money. The staff is unsympathetic. I brought my cat in over a week ago. The doctor talks to us about the tests the next day, and another doctor the next day. I'm disappointed and angry. They deserve to close down due to their lack of control over the building. They're ALL unpleasant and don't know how to do their job. My cat was returned in a SHOE BOX FROM THE BACK. I say this because that's what they really are (beggars). They don't want to work. I'll give them my word. I ALSO EMPHASIZE THAT THEY DON'T EARN MONEY, BUT THEY STEAL IT...

THIEFS!!!!!!!!!!!!!°°°°°°°

Terrible experience, unsympathetic, cold staff... I've been to this clinic twice, and both times they returned my poor cat (I had two) in a shoebox. "Otherwise it would be rude for the customers to see a lifeless animal returned," they said. And not even from the doctor who treated her, but from a nurse who simply said "sorry" and then walked away, almost closing the door in my face.
In my opinion, the staff were insensitive and didn't even bother to make a negative impact on the kitten's health, even when a child was present.
NEVER AGAIN... Highly discouraged.
Terrible service, rude and expensive too… bad experience.
Kind, helpful humans

Truly very important experiences, my Lilly, who suffered from very serious pulmonary edema in July, was treated with love and unparalleled professionalism. Her quality of life is truly normal, despite her 13 years. My little epileptic Bruno, with Dr. Tarsitano, is a dog who has started living again after being neglected by the inefficient care of three important neurologists in Rome. I can only thank all the clinic staff for the love and dedication they put into caring for these little patients. 👏👏👏👏👏👏

I want to thank all the staff and technical personnel at the Omniavet clinic, but a special thanks goes to Dr. Menasci, who cared for our Zoe with passion, professionalism, and compassion throughout her illness. I will always remember the kindness and support she gave me and my sweet Zoe, even during the most difficult times. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Thank you so much for saving Striscia's life. The staff is truly professional and attentive to each of our needs, and ready to help us in times of emergency.

I thank everyone for their skill, humanity, empathy, and kindness. A special thanks to Fabio Tarsitano and Alessandro De Cesare
who were wonderful. Despite everything, a sincere thank you ❤️.
Tania D'Orazio (Leo).

For years now, they've cared for our dogs with professionalism, empathy, and passion. Friendly and patient, they explain everything they do clearly and transparently, easing the inevitable anxieties and doubts of those who bring their pets.

I came to the clinic with my German Shepherd with numerous allergies, both environmental and food-related, chronic diarrhea, sometimes with blood, vomiting, scratching wounds, and lesions on the anal glands and surrounding areas.
Dr. Elena San Giorgi was professional; I appreciated the fact that she always followed us closely and was always available. She addressed everything, and now the dog is doing well, and we are also managing the environmental issues.
She was empathetic and kind towards us and affectionate towards my dog; in my case, I can say that she is one of those people who are instantly likeable.

Unfortunately, due to the unavailability of our trusted veterinarian, we urgently contacted the Omnia Vet clinic in Ostia for our rabbit, who was showing worrying signs of intestinal disease. Upon our arrival, we were immediately informed that the rabbit had an intestinal blockage, a highly sensitive condition for this species, and that hospitalization would be necessary.

We understand the potentially serious nature of the situation, but from the very beginning, it seemed to us that the clinic's approach was excessively alarmist, generating significant anxiety and stress, despite the presence of clinical signs that—although requiring monitoring—did not yet appear critical (the rabbit was eating and drinking, albeit little). Almost immediately, we were told about a possible operation, as if it were already obvious, even before carrying out in-depth tests. This approach left us perplexed, as they chose to anticipate serious scenarios without having yet collected complete diagnostic data.

During the hospital stay, communication was often difficult: the receptionist seemed unsympathetic and rude, especially when we sought updates on our pet's health. The impression was that the organization was more focused on financial matters than on interpersonal relationships and emotional support for the owners in a delicate situation.

One aspect that particularly struck us was the constant reference to the possibility that the rabbit could die at any moment, despite the reassuring or improving results from the tests. At every step, there seemed to be a new potential life-threatening risk, justifying a further hospital stay or new tests, creating a climate of constant tension and guilt, bordering on psychological pressure.

The visit itself was equally frustrating: before showing us the rabbit, they held us for almost an hour, discussing only the costs and the possibility of further hospitalization, with an insistent attitude that showed little respect for our emotional state. Only after insistence were we able to see the rabbit, who—contrary to what we had been told—appeared alert and active, was eating and drinking, and the IVs were disconnected. At that point, on the advice of our trusted breeder, we decided to discontinue hospitalization, despite being strongly advised against it.

Fortunately, the next day our trusted veterinarian reassessed the situation with new x-rays and checks: the intestinal blockage was resolving well, thanks to the initial treatment (IVs and support), and there was no real need for surgery or further hospitalization. Furthermore, we were able to compare some of the statements received at the clinic with other professional opinions, which confirmed that the risks had been significantly amplified.

We don't question the facility's technical expertise—the rabbit was stabilized, however, and we are grateful for that—but we cannot overlook the communication, financial, and management approach, which seemed focused on exploiting the owners' emotions rather than ensuring a transparent clinical process. The immediate request for a deposit even before obtaining a clinical picture, the constant emotional pressure, the attempt to prolong the hospitalization despite improvements, and the financial insistence are all factors that lead us to strongly advise against this facility for those seeking not only good care for their pet, but also humanity, clarity, and respect.

We hope this testimony can help others evaluate carefully. Always read reviews before entrusting yourself to a clinic: unfortunately, we did so too late.

A special thank you to Dr. Rachel Menasci, who cared for my Moggie with professionalism, kindness, and great availability.
Her passion for animals is evident from the first touch. Her ability to put both animals and their owners at ease is truly special.
Thanks again to her and all the staff.

For many years, we have been cared for, advised, and supported by the entire staff of this veterinary clinic, primarily by Dr. Alessandro De Cesare, the invaluable nurse Daniela, Dr. Tarsitano, Dr. Gaspari, and Dr. Sartori, for our puppies.
We have found a staff with the warmth of a family ❤️.
Thank you again for everything you do, from Rossana, Emanuele, Chiara, Bea, and Luce, and...

Bad experience. I brought my cat because she was sick at 9 pm. The visit lasted three minutes, and it was a quick, sloppy, and painful examination for the cat. They diagnosed a spinal problem, the cat was semi-seized, and they sent us a €70 bill with no treatment. It would have been the same if I hadn't gone. Terrible!
You don't even deserve a star for the lady with glasses and long hair who sits at the entrance and always answers rudely in different ways... to say the least... and not just about her...
Professional and polite staff. They cared for and saved my dog ​​Zoe in several very critical situations. Thanks to all the staff, especially Dr. De Cesare.

I'd like to thank Dr. Gaspari for his professionalism and kindness, and the entire clinic staff in general. Up until now, taking my Dexter to the vet had always been a source of stress (for both of us)... 5 stars is not enough. Thank you.

TERRIFYING EXPERIENCE.
I don't usually leave reviews, especially reviews like this, but I truly wouldn't wish what we went through on anyone.
I brought my dog ​​in urgently because he was sick and they operated on him, and depending on the doctor you see, they tell you different things. First, the dog showed signs of a problem, so they decided to operate on him. Then, the next day, they thought it was stomach problems, but no, but by then they had proceeded with the operation. On the last day, the problem recurred, this is because three doctors and three different versions. In the midst of all this, they call in the middle of the night telling you the dog is very sick and so they'll sedate him. I call back at lunchtime and am dismissed over the phone, saying the appointment time is at 6 pm. Zero empathy, they're money-grubbing machines. Without any kind of love. To this day, I don't know what caused my dog's death.
In all of this, €2,000 in three days to return without him!

I must thank the clinic staff, from the receptionist to the doctor (whose name I don't know), for the kindness and empathy with which they handled my situation. Unfortunately, there was nothing that could be done for my 17-year-old cat, Minou. We rushed to perform euthanasia, and were treated with a kindness that we have not forgotten, despite the tragic moment. Thank you again, and keep up the good work.

Unfortunately, it's a terrible clinic. People who've been there have advised me against it. Plus, I read about the poor black cat that was from a colony at Camping Fabulous. They don't even give a damn. They're only concerned about money. It's a disgrace to quote that amount. Luckily, there are other, much more humane clinics.

Professional and kind doctors and nurses.
They took care of our cat and, above all, were patient with us owners, which is sometimes the hardest part.
We brought my 1-year-old dog because he had swelling on his face. Professionalism and courtesy. I sincerely thank the doctor. Excellent visit.

I'm giving it one star only because I can't give it zero. They killed my cat for the modest sum of €1,000 or more, and in the space of four days. We trusted them, asking for impartial advice. We proceeded with the operation, which involved amputating a leg at the age of 15 for a bone tumor. They discharged her after a day without even running any tests, and despite our calls to let them know how sick the kitten was, they made us wait to bring her in. The result: a cat with jaundice, anemic, liver degeneration, fever, and malnutrition. And the kitten was already in those conditions when they let us take her home, reassuring us that these were normal reactions to the major surgery she'd undergone. She was hospitalized for another night, and attempts to restore the cat's condition were made with ferocity and only worsened. They advised us again to try to save her rather than euthanize her immediately, given her suffering. We trusted them again. She died alone during the night, in agony. We received the news in the morning, making the cat's death seem like a recent event, which wasn't true because they specified that they had already placed her in the cold room, even though I would have gone to get her immediately. A surgery they said would be a sure success, aimed at improving and prolonging my cat's life, turned out to be a fatal decision for her. In hindsight, we would have let her live a little longer, cuddling her with us, and then ended her life without suffering. I knew it would end this way, and I bitterly regret not listening to my instincts. I had hoped to keep the kitten with me longer, and they took advantage of this strong feeling. There were reasons to understand that she wasn't the right cat for this kind of operation, but unfortunately, when money is involved, the heart is put on hold.
